scope: Libraries linked statically into release desktop executables (scripts/build_desktop_release.sh). Each download is checked against its SHA-256 before use.

sdl2.verified: SHA-256 equals the digest GitHub publishes for the release asset

llvm-mingw-x86_64.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (toolchain only; the executable links its MinGW-w64 runtime statically)
llvm-mingw-x86_64.verified: SHA-256 equals the digest GitHub publishes for the release asset
llvm-mingw-x86_64.use: Windows arm64 cross-compiler, on an x86_64 Linux build host

sdl2-aros-patch.use: AROS x86-64 port of the pinned sdl2 source (scripts/build_desktop_amiga.sh)

sdl2-aros-static.verified: SHA-256 of the file at that commit of github.com/aros-development-team/contrib

sdl2-aros-intern.verified: SHA-256 of the file at that commit of github.com/aros-development-team/contrib

sdl2-amigaos3.verified: MD5 220f9ea9e94c3e2c6a5054822c05c08f equals the pin in DevilutionX 3rdParty/SDL2/CMakeLists.txt for its AmigaOS 3 m68k release
sdl2-amigaos3.use: AmigaOS 3.x m68k SDL2 (68040, FPU, RTG), built static with CMake (scripts/build_desktop_amiga.sh)

docker-images.use: x86_64-aros-gcc 9.1.0 with the AROS SDK in /opt/x86_64-aros
m68k-amigaos-gcc (bebbo), libnix, CMake toolchain file in CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE
the amigaos-m68k image; vasmm68k_mot from it assembles SDL's AGA c2p
